first_public_release.strategy: No previous production build is assumed. Keep a same-signing-identity hotfix path ready, increment versionCode, preserve save/profile and entitlement compatibility, and disable server-side monetization features only when doing so is safe and reversible.

subsequent_updates.strategy: Halt rollout on release-blocking evidence, keep the last known-good production version serving existing users where platform behavior permits, and publish only a higher-versionCode corrective build. Never require a client downgrade.

immediate_stop_conditions: new blocker or critical product defect
save corruption, data loss or incompatible migration
purchase, restore, refund or revocation entitlement failure
required_compatibility: new hotfix can load all saves accepted by the candidate
verified entitlements survive hotfix and reinstall
backend/API changes remain backward compatible with the last public client

completion_requirements: all required prerequisite completion records exist, report pass and belong to the RC ancestry
candidate commit/version/AAB/signing identity agree with 12.6 and tested 12.7 evidence
every final regression checklist item is true on the same candidate
rollback owner and incident channel are real non-placeholder values
first-release hotfix recipe is verified and rollback dry run is recorded
final go/no-go decision is explicitly go
